$comment: Spells (D&D 5e SRD), cast with right click / R; the quick bar's keys 1-5 pick which. There are no spell slots: each spell has a recovery (seconds) before it can be cast again, and a short rest recovers them all. minLevel: the hero level a spell is learnt at. kind: bolt (a projectile; a spell attack, d20 + proficiency + casting ability, against AC), missiles (count darts that always hit), burst (everyone within radius px of the point aimed at — or of the caster when range is 0 — rolls a save against the spell DC: full damage on a failure, half on a success), heal (the caster, dice + casting ability). damage: dice notation; damageType: fire, cold, lightning, force, necrotic, radiant, thunder, acid. effect: [shape, colour] from src/assets/Effects.ts, played where it strikes (and as its icon); effectScale sizes it.
